wikipediaBodyRead.title: Israelites
wikipediaBodyRead.supportJa: L191 explicitly says Israelites are also known as Children of Israel and describes them as a people; it supports a collective reading without deciding every occurrence in Kings.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「イスラエルの戦車と騎兵」はイスラエルの民を指す表現として集団カードの初出に採用。ヤコブ個人・地理領域とは区別。
occurrenceChecks.text: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 列王記下3:3は、ヤロブアムがイスラエルに罪を犯させたと記します。
occurrenceChecks.text: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 列王記下3:6でヨラムはイスラエル全体を召集します。
occurrenceChecks.text: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 列王記下3:24は、イスラエル人がモアブ人を打ったと記します。
occurrenceChecks.text: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 列王記下3:27は、イスラエルに大きな怒りが及んだと記します。
occurrenceChecks.text: Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 列王記下7:13では、イスラエルの残った人々と滅びた人々が比べられます。
occurrenceChecks.text: One of his servants answered, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed. Let’s send and see.”

identityCheckJa: 2KI2:12の「イスラエルの戦車と騎兵」を集団用法として扱う。各節の「イスラエル」が王国・地理を指す場合は地理プロフィール、個人ヤコブを指す場合は別の文脈プロフィールに分ける。

primaryWitnesses.text: until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he said by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away out of their own land to Assyria to this day.
